name: Titu Mir
role: Peasant resistance leader against colonial authority
contribution: He led a major agrarian resistance movement against oppressive zamindari and colonial structures in early 19th-century Bengal.
context: His mobilization combined social, religious, and anti-colonial grievances in a volatile rural colonial economy.
impact: He remains a prominent symbol of grassroots resistance in Bengal political memory.
highlight: A landmark figure of peasant anti-colonial resistance.
seoTitle: Titu Mir: Peasant Resistance in Bengal
seoDescription: Explore Titu Mir's agrarian resistance and the bamboo-fort uprising against zamindari and colonial authority in Bengal.
shortAnswer: Titu Mir was a peasant resistance leader who fought oppressive zamindari and colonial structures in early nineteenth-century Bengal.
